title: NR Polar Encoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/NR_Polar_Encoder.md
text: Perform polar encoding according to 5G NR standard, 4 inputs, 3 outputs; {Link direction} sets the direction of 5G NR, {Configuration source} sets the source for K, {Message length (K)} sets the length of information block in bits and {Rate-matched length (E)} sets the rate-matched output length in bits. Values come from the instance.
